subject: [hw] K02 -> IK: nord2_vcodec.inc final (sha a939f107); please regenerate 0299 + run compile_check on YOUR final relay
body:
F1-F4 from R2 are all in my file now (0x3000 windows, MDP bit 19 + CLK_CFG_1 root checks, close-all slot handling with one server_close per slot, 0xfff01 on larb7/8). My file also has the RWVC_DMA_INFO pool side and the sleeping WAIT_IRQ/POLL (msleep 500 us, mutex dropped, revalidate f->used/id + n2vc.on[blk]).

My file: sha256 a939f107bef82e02, no changes planned unless R2 finds something.
Host: bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k02/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST K02 PASS 588871/588871 (violations 0) x2.

Your relay is still changing (proc refs/reaper/DMA_INFO at 16:08-16:15), so 0299 is stale and compile_check has not run on the combined tree. When your relay is final, please run kern/compile_check.sh (it regenerates 0299 from the current bsd/dev files and checks 0 unknown). I ran the equivalent locally on a /tmp copy of the q10at3 stage + 0298 + the three .inc + both headers with the CI flags: clean, 1,318,688-byte object, 9 new undefined symbols all defined in the q10at3 kernel. No action for me if your run is green; if it fails, send me the error lines that name nord2_vcodec.inc.
